unlisted_practices: Building LLM educational feedback chatbots with a no-code workflow platform (Dify, Slack, Google Apps Script)
Loop-based iterative comment feedback versus single-shot feedback design grounded in formative assessment theory
Deidentification protocol and API-based data protection for clinical educational case report content
Human-in-the-loop oversight of AI feedback in clinical education

screen.reason: This tutorial and feasibility study piloted an LLM-based feedback system (with built-in deidentification and feedback workflows) with novice hospital staff and instructors, evaluating feasibility and usability rather than testing outcomes with and without a specific guardrail.
